data.name: Prithvansh
data.gender_notes: Prithvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prithvi means earth and Ansh means soul or self. Together, it means the Lord of the Earth or the ruler of the Earth. The name Prithvansh carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Prithvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine connection between the individual and the earth, representing stability, strength, and nurturing.
data.etymology: Prithvansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prithvansh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Prithvansh" holds deep cultural significance in Hinduism. Prithvi, being an important elemen in the five basic elements (Panch Mahabhutas), is associated with soil, stability, and power. Additionally, it is an ancient royal name with the ruling figures traced back to Lord Rama. This name suggests strength, power, and regal essence.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Prithvansh represents a strong connection with the Earth and its energies. It signifies the embodiment of physical and spiritual stability, and a recognition of our earthly existence. As the earth is our foundation, this name underscores our spiritual bond with the physical world, our roots, and our past.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Prithvansh: Rooted in the earth (Prithvi), ruled by the celestial deity (Sha). This name signifies a strong connection to the earthly realm, combined with a divine and authoritative influence.

historical_references.reference: Prithviraj Chauhan I, the Chahamana king, ruled from 1179 to 1192 CE. He is remembered for his brave resistance against the Muslim invader Muhammad Ghori. Prithviraj Chauhan I was the last Hindu ruler of Delhi before the Delhi Sultanate was established.
historical_references.context: Last Hindu ruler of Delhi before the establishment of the Delhi Sultanate

historical_references.reference: Prithviraj III, belonging to the Prithvi Raj Sisodia Rajput clan, ruled from 1283 to 1308 CE. He is known for his military campaigns against the Delhi Sultanate and the Vaghelas of Gujarat. Prithviraj III is also remembered for his patronage of art, literature, and religious institutions.
historical_references.context: Military campaigns against the Delhi Sultanate and the Vaghelas of Gujarat; patronage of art, literature, and religious institutions

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Prithvansh' is derived from Hindu mythology, where Prithvi is one of the primary deities representing the earth element. The 'sh' suffix denotes the dynasty founded by the legendary king Prithvi Raj Chauhan. In modern times, this name is often used as a mark of pride and connection to Indian heritage, particularly on social media platforms like Twitter, Reddit, and Instagram. Users may share stories, images, and information related to Prithvansh to engage with their communities and celebrate their ancestry and genealogy.

name_in_real_life.story: Priya Prithvansh from Bali, Indonesia embodies the meaning of Prithvansh - "Lord of the Earth". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
